thesis: The speakers argue that Entrepreneur First operates as a talent investor that identifies and supports high-ambition individuals before they form companies, aiming to unlock founders who are currently missing from the market. They further contend that ambition is the most underrated force for societal change because ambitious people across all eras seek leverage, and the specific 'technology of ambition' available in any given time and place—such as literacy in the medieval period—determines the scale of impact those individuals can achieve.
